title: SLO封存、故障注入与精确断言辅助

reserved_local_resource.policy: First Provision: verify a new full owner token, canonical contained fresh root and free reserved loopback port before creating anything; cluster system id and database OID cannot be required before they exist. Initialize only that owned cluster, then record and verify system id, endpoint, database OID/name/owner, setup/runtime roles and permissions before test use. Subsequent test/crash/restart/stop must match all recorded identities, contained paths, session_user and expected sessions; refuse unknown or mismatched instances. Setup/admin credentials separate from restricted runtime DML role (NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOINHERIT NOBYPASSRLS). Fresh SCRAM credentials remain private, never printed or committed. Requested crash is limited to exact own cluster and labeled; smart-stop normally, preserve data/logs/failures, never terminate unknown sessions, reuse old task roots or touch5432. A failed initial Provision retains its owned marker and partial evidence; recovery first proves exactly which resources were created and never assumes a missing OID is valid runtime identity.

entry_conditions: 读取任务卡固定来源与当前已确认主线；逐项确认直接前置的实际远端交付及合同/包版本。
条件消费路径逐条核验卡片绑定；不适用需说明依据，未交付的真实提供者不可用stub绕过；协调对话确认共享写入窗口。
